answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Fifty slots per epoch; top bids win, locked 20 epochs as a bond. A bridge check ties each bid to one history, so one history funds one bid. A prism review splits a record into work, referrals, and disputes, exposing clone patterns. An island account with no partners must bid twice the median, so 500 fakes cost 10,000 credits against a 2,000 gain. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
